notes: Read-domain checks are clocked on i_clk_rd, not i_clk_wr as in the template. CHK-001 and CHK-003 have no disable iff. CHK-001 only samples at i_clk_rd edges, so it cannot check the same-time-step reset response, and the first-edge-after-release check reads the pre-edge value. CHK-002 has a second assertion, a_CHK_002_a, for part (a). It shares the CHK-002 fail counter, and hits_CHK_002 counts only part (b). CHK-004 compares each value at posedge i_clk_rd with a copy captured at the preceding negedge. It therefore misses glitches between a posedge and the next negedge. Nothing here has been compiled or run in Verilator.
